FABLE UNIT 3 DELIVERED — PAYMENT-AUTHENTICATION CONTINUATION (3DS). Branch claude/durable-payment-port-20260909 @ 4a7463e (on 8baaead / 30e8b7a; base 4c81572). Handoff: .xenios/handoffs/2026-09-09T14-30-00Z-DURABLE-PURCHASING-UNITS-fable-durable-payment-20260909.md (all three units + exact remaining seams).
SERVER: commerce/checkout-continuation.ts — createCheckoutContinuationService({store, provider, executor}) with status()/continue(); owner-only via the store's member-scoped lookup plus a re-check (foreign record == not found); the client secret is read FRESH from the provider snapshot (PaymentSnapshot.clientSecret, additive in providers/payment.ts) only while the provider says pending AND the snapshot names this execution's amount/order/member; continue() while still pending changes nothing (no claim, no provider call, no second payment); once the provider moved on it CAS-claims action_required->authorizing and runs the coordinator, so the result comes from the provider read-back, never the redirect. registerCheckoutContinuationApi(app, {requireActiveMember}, {service}): GET /api/research/checkout/executions/:requestKey/continuation and POST .../continue, subject via routes.subjectOf, private no-store headers, request-key validation, errors never echoed.
CLIENT (not mounted; mount seam is yours): adapters/checkoutContinuation.ts and payments/PaymentAuthenticationStep.tsx — injected authenticator (default Stripe.js handleNextAction loaded from js.stripe.com, key supplied by the caller), secret held in memory only (asserted absent from the DOM), principal fence on token change/unmount, explicit uncertain state with "do not pay again", cancelled/failed confirmation => "nothing has been charged", onCompleted fired once.
EXECUTED: 318/318 across continuation (10), processor (15), binding (18), port (19), coordinator (8), webhooks, routes, payment adapter, and the jsdom step test (5); full tsc exit 0. Provider mode: real StripePaymentAdapter over the in-test idempotency model (commerce/stripe-model.test-helper.ts) — local qualification only, no Stripe test-mode/managed call.
FOR YOU (once): (1) execution-store contract + migration candidate (records with UNIQUE(member,request key), version CAS, atomic commitCaptured/commitCancelled, findByProviderReference/findByOrder, webhook inbox UNIQUE(provider_name,event_id)+digest+state) — my units compile against the interfaces in durable-checkout-executor.ts / webhook-execution-processor.ts; (2) composition behind the readiness boundary (resolver stays Disabled until then); (3) authorized Stripe test-mode + staging run for the connected journey; (4) independent review of these Fable-authored commits. If you name the store contract or a different path, I implement against it next; otherwise I take order/account visibility of executions (customer history showing pending/authenticating/completed truthfully) as the next disjoint unit.
